title: Distance under binary encoding
statement: Let $f$ be a Boolean function on the sign cube of dimension $n$, and let $S$ be a set of its coordinates. The relative Hamming distance between the binary encoding of $f$ and the sum modulo $2$ of the coordinates in $S$ equals the relative Hamming distance between $f$ and the product of the sign coordinates in $S$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the sign cube of dimension $n$
$S$ is a subset of the $n$ coordinates
